context: This criteria evaluates the engineer's proficiency in using the use-sync-external-store package to build an external store with efficient subscription patterns, selector-based memoization, and custom equality functions for performance optimization.

checklist.name: Store subscribe implementation
checklist.description: The store implements a subscribe method that accepts a callback function and returns an unsubscribe function. The subscribe method must maintain a list of listeners and call them when state changes. The unsubscribe function must properly remove the listener to prevent memory leaks.

checklist.name: Store getSnapshot implementation
checklist.description: The store implements a getSnapshot method that returns the current state snapshot. The snapshot must be cached/memoized between state changes to prevent infinite loops, as required by useSyncExternalStore API contract.

checklist.name: useSyncExternalStore usage
checklist.description: Components use useSyncExternalStore (or useSyncExternalStoreWithSelector) from the use-sync-external-store package to subscribe to the external store. The hook must be called with the store's subscribe and getSnapshot functions.

checklist.name: Selector pattern implementation
checklist.description: CartSummary component uses useSyncExternalStoreWithSelector with a selector function that extracts only the needed data (itemCount and totalPrice) from the full store snapshot. The selector transforms the full state into a derived summary object.

checklist.name: Custom equality function
checklist.description: CartSummary uses the isEqual parameter of useSyncExternalStoreWithSelector to provide a custom equality function that performs structural comparison of the summary object. The equality function must compare the itemCount and totalPrice fields to prevent re-renders when only irrelevant fields (like lastUpdated) change.

checklist.name: Item-specific selection
checklist.description: CartItem component uses useSyncExternalStoreWithSelector with a selector that extracts only the specific item by ID from the items array. This ensures the component only has access to its own item's data.

checklist.name: Item isolation equality
checklist.description: CartItem uses a custom isEqual function that compares item properties (name, price, quantity) to prevent re-renders when other items in the cart change. This achieves proper component isolation where each CartItem only re-renders when its specific item data changes.
